data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Masha total 15, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.

in_hebrew.name: מַשָּׁה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Masha is derived from the Hebrew word 'mashah', which means 'Who is like God?'. This is a powerful and thought-provoking name, reminding us of the greatness and majesty of God.

in_greek.name: Μασά
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Masha in Greek is derived from the word 'masa', which means 'Rescued'. This name is a reminder of God's saving power and faithfulness to His people.

in_latin.name: Mascha
in_latin.long_meaning: In Latin, the name Masha is simply transliterated from the Greek form of the name. It is not derived from any specific Latin word or meaning.
